result.subject: Welcome to our London office – Thursday 12 November
result.body:
Dear Regulator liaison team,

We look forward to welcoming you on Thursday 12 November at 15:00 for a due diligence session.

Our office is located at 3rd Floor, 21 Copper Row, London EC2A 4LT.

Upon arrival, please proceed to the reception on the ground floor, present photo ID to collect building passes, and follow the signs to Meeting room 1.

You will be greeted by our CRO, who will meet you in Meeting room 1.

Agenda:
- Welcome and introductions
- Company and control‑environment overview
- Document walkthrough and Q&A
- Follow‑up requests and next steps

Kind regards,
Business Operations
